blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Vice President Sara Z. Duterte’s declared business interests and alleged government transactions involving companies linked to her will come under closer scrutiny this week as House of Representatives prosecutors turn to corporate and procurement records as evidence on her alleged unexplained wealth under Article II of the Articles of Impeachment. Civil Service Commission Assistant Commissioner Ariel Ronquillo, Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Company Registration and Monitoring Department Director Gerardo del Rosario, and Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System division chief Rendell Sopeña are lined up as the next witnesses when the Senate impeachment court resumes trial Monday.
